title: Grimoire Archive: Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose missing Grimoire entries by checking Terminal wiring, providers, and bridge data.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: If entries are missing, check Terminal registration, provider order, route unlocks, and whether the optional bridge returned any data.

blocks.title: Read The State
blocks.body: A locked entry and a missing entry are different problems. Locked means pacing; missing means content or provider wiring.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Add one archive entry, verify it appears, then add generated records. Bulk archive generation can hide a bad provider id.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
